jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Thirdera is looking for a highly skilled Quality Assurance Analyst to join our Spain team!

Who is Thirdera?

Thirdera is the largest pure play ServiceNow partner worldwide. We strive to make smarter ways of working a reality as we generate transformation, digitization, and automation for our customers at the speed of NOW. Thirdera brings together the power of the ServiceNow platform and its limitless potential across the world of work. Our global team of ServiceNow experts helps our customers realize workflow automation and gain maximum platform value.

Your mission:

Your mission as a Quality Assurance Analyst is to perform a variety of tests, report bugs, reviewing and analyzing system specifications, executing test scripts and reviewing results, reporting and documenting technical issues. You will create Test Cases, following standard and best practices), review user interfaces for consistency and functionality, run manual and automated test, develop standards and procedures to... determine product quality and release readiness, write and execute test scripts, and you will have good and timely communication with the team and client.

What's in it for you?

We offer a fun, highly engaging and unique culture. You'll get the best learning and career experience from day 1, by being able to work with ServiceNow Experts, access certifications and accreditations and the opportunity to grow in the ServiceNow practice.

You'll be empowered to work for top of the line companies and amazing partners, while having fun at it!

Who are we looking for? ​

We are seeking confident, curious, and experienced Quality Assurance Analyst that can perform a variety of tests, Report Bugs, reviewing and analyzing system specifications, executing test scripts and reviewing results, reporting and documenting technical issues.

Requirements:
• 2+ years of experience working in QA testing.
• ServiceNow SysAdmin Certification – Desired
• ITIL Foundations Certified – Desired.
• Certified Tester Foundation Level – Desired.
• Experience working with the tool Postman and testing integration tests – Desired.
• Experience creating documentation in English.
• Identify different test scenarios in a requirement.
• Test Cases creation (standard & best practices).
• Identify negative test scenarios.
• Review User Interfaces for Consistency & Functionality.
• Analytical Thinking.
• Break Project into Attainable Progress Goals.
• Strong Written & Verbal Communication.
• Perform and Document Risk Analysis.
• Computer Science or Engineering degree or an equivalent preferred.
• Defect management.
• Experience using testing tools.

Salary Range:

Welcome to Pay for Performance! We provide competitive compensation, generous benefits and a professional and culturally diverse work environment. Work-life balance is very important to us so our job opportunities allow for remote working and flexible schedules so you can manage your own time.

This is a remote opportunity

jobs_results.title: Mid Level QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
Mid Level QA Tester - Automation
Málaga
Málaga, Andalusia, ES

Company Description We help the world see new possibilities and inspire change for better tomorrows. Our analytic solutions bridge content, data, and analytics to help business, people, and society become stronger, more resilient, and sustainable. Job Description Responsible for the accurate testing of software used by insurance market professionals. Works under limited supervision and helps direct the work of more junior QA Analysts. Main Responsibilities
• Gradually performs manual testing in more complex areas across the application.
• Able to create automatic tests and maintain them
• Able to own small-to-medium features with guidance from test case design through implementation to completion.
• Capable of designing moderately complex test cases.
• Conducts exploratory testing to find promptly defects.
• Provides accurate estimates for themselves and others.
• Identifies solutions to issues blocking testing with... minimal assistance.
• Reviews test cases executed by less experienced testers.
• Reviews User Stories, as well as testable requirements providing feedback.
• Logging and tracking defects of their area.
• Proactively engages with analysts to get more business knowledge.
• Any other duties commensurate to the grade of the role.
Qualifications Knowledge and Experience:
• 2+ years experience in similar roles.
• Knowledgeable in SQL scripting (having its own queries set), SQL server and data model.
• Working experience with TFS and Visual Studio.
• Analytical mind and problem-solving aptitude to face more complex business scenarios.
• High attention to detail.
• Ability to express complex bugs, situations or problems in a concise and precise manner.
• Creativity when dealing with new and illogical situations.
• Learns from experience when looking for potential problems and solutions.
• Capable of prioritising tasks; avoids getting caught up in unimportant details.
Desirable Experience/knowledge
• . Net
• Selenium
• Playwright
• JMeter
• ISTQB Certification
1 Additional Information For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster. At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed. For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work for outstanding workplace culture in the US, fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and second consecutive year in Poland. We value learning, caring and results and make inclusivity and diversity a top priority. In addition to our Great Place to Work Certification, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer and Best Employer for Women, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture. We’re 7, 000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations. Verisk Businesses Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences Property Estimating Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient Extreme Event Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to extreme events. Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing, relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement Life Insurance Solutions – offers end-to-end, data insight-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group. Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, veteran's status, age or disability. html Unsolicited resumes sent to Verisk, including unsolicited resumes sent to a Verisk business mailing address, fax machine or email address, or directly to Verisk employees, will be considered Verisk property. Verisk will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

jobs_results.title: Technology Senior Specialist Quality Assurance
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a Technology Senior Specialist Quality Assurance to be part of our IT Marketing, Sales and eBusiness Department (MSE).

Position Snapshot

+ Location: Nestlé Global Tech Hub in Barcelona, Spain

+ Type of Contract: Permanent

+ Stream: IT Marketing, Sales and eBusiness (MSE)

+ Type of work: Hybrid

+ Work Language: Fluent Business English

The role

In order to complete our Digital Experiences Technologies Department, we are currently looking for a Quality Assurance (QA) Senior Technology Specialist.

What you’ll do

• Develop and implement a comprehensive QA strategy for delivery, aligned with industry best practices and standards.

• Collaborate with the development teams and agencies to integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline.

• Design automated and detailed defect reports and analysis to stakeholders, highlighting critical issues and trends.

• Communicate test progress, results, and risks to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.

•... Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard tools and frameworks.

• Define and enforce QA processes, methodologies, and tools to ensure consistent and efficient testing across releases.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish quality goals and metrics for the overall Digital Experience ecosystem.

• Collaborate with the development team and agency to define test plans, test cases, and test data for each release.

• Conduct thorough functional, regression, and performance testing to ensure the stability and functionality of the platform.

• Execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and identify defects and areas for improvement.

• Identify opportunities for test automation and work towards increasing test coverage and efficiency.

• Track and manage defects throughout the testing lifecycle, ensuring timely resolution and closure.

• Collaborate with the development team and agency to prioritize and resolve defects based on impact and severity.

• Work closely with the development team and agency to ensure clear understanding of requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Business Analysts and Product Owners, to validate business requirements and user stories.

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

+ Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.

+ Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.

+ Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!

+ Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Proven experience as a QA professional, in a consumer facing digital environment.

• Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks is highly desirable.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently and drive results.

• Do-er, hand-on attitude and hunger for process improvements.

About the IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé’s IT Hub #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed: You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day

Sobre la empresa:
Nestle

jobs_results.title: Senior Quality Assurance Tester
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de la experiencia Exceltic, una empresa con estrategia centrada en las personas?

¿Tienes inquietud por conocer el sector técnico y tecnológico?

¡Ésta es tu oportunidad!👇

Estamos buscando desde Exceltic a un/a QA Tester con experiencia en pruebas manuales con interés en desarrollarse en pruebas automatizadas. La persona seleccionada será parte de nuestro equipo interno de QA. El trabajo se desarrollará en una modalidad hibrida (formato flexible de Teletrabajo) con asistencia a las oficinas de Madrid ubicadas en las Rozas para hacer piña con el resto del equipo.

✅Tus funciones se centrarán en:

· Diseño de los casos de prueba

· Ejecución de pruebas manuales.

· Automatización de batería de pruebas.

· Pruebas de servicios.

🔎¿Qué buscamos?
• Formación técnica como FPII o Ingeniería (preferiblemente)
• Experiencia de al menos 5 años en Testing Funcional.
• Deseable experiencia en herramientas como JIRA-XRAY, Testlink.
• Deseable experiencia con herramientas... como Postman o SoapUi.
• Deseable experiencia con herramienta de gestión de defectos: Mantis
• Deseable conocimientos en Selenium, Cypress y/o JMeter.

🙌Ofrecemos:

1. Posición estable.

2. Contrato indefinido.

3. Plan de retribución flexible (seguro médico, ticket transporte, restaurante y guardería).

4. Plan de formación.

5. Horario flexible con posibilidad de teletrabajo (formato remoto).

💫Vivir la experiencia Exceltic significa:
• Participar en proyectos punteros en donde puedas desarrollar tus habilidades.
• Percibir un salario competitivo en función de aportación.
• Disfrutar de un plan de retribución flexible.
• Equilibrar tu vida personal y profesional.
• Formar parte de un equipo en el que te sientas escuchado/a y en donde puedas aportar nuevas ideas.

💬Acerca de nosotros…

Somos una empresa de servicios de ingeniería y consultoría tecnológica. Desarrollamos nuestra actividad en distintos sectores (Ferroviario, Aeronáutico, Espacio, Defensa, Energía, Automoción, Industria, Tecnologías de la Información y Telecomunicaciones). También proporcionamos servicios de auditoría técnica y formación especializada.

A día de hoy contamos con una sólida cartera de clientes multinacionales en los distintos sectores y una de las ofertas más completas del mercado.

En la familia Exceltic Somos más de 450 miembros y contamos con oficinas en Madrid, Barcelona y Bilbao y con proyectos en los cinco continentes.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo

jobs_results.title: SENIOR QA TESTER
jobs_results.description:
Embrace the gaming revolution with Maniac Panda Games, the video game studio powered by Nexxyo Labs! We're not just imagining; we're actively crafting new ways to immerse players in the exhilarating world of gaming.

Are you ready to redefine how the world enjoys games?

We’re looking for SENIOR QA TESTER to join us! Requisitos mínimos

You have 2 years of experience in game testing (any platform).
You have gaming knowledge and passion.
You have good attention to detail.
You have good communication and organizational skills.
You have experience working with Jira and Confluence.
You have Agile working methodologies.
You are used to the game development process.
You are able to work with remote teams.
English Language - at least a basic conversation level is required, the team is growing internationally.
Requisitos deseados

You have degree in Game Design, Art or Programming.
You have equivalent experience like Software Testing or Game Journalism.
You have Automation Testing skills.
You... have Game engine experience (Unreal, Unity, GameMaker, etc.).
Responsabilidades

Creation and maintenance of Test Cases and Checklist for Smoke and Functional Testing.
Integral testing of projects from its first Alpha to post-launch.
Knowledge of the tools needed for testing videogames on PC, video recording, and edition.
Detailed and efficient reporting of issues, feedback and improvements on those projects.
Regression checks on the issues already fixed by the Design and Development Team.
Direct coordination with that Team and active participation in continuous meetings.
Comprehensive maintenance of the Issue Database health and issue triage in Atlassian Jira.
Organization, creation, and review of documentation in Atlassian Confluence.
Beneficios

Industry competitive salary based on experience and skills.
Flexible working hours.
Reduced working hours in August.
Participate in the AAA videogame company with the greatest projection in Spain.
Being part of a studio with a team of more than 100 professionals in Marketing, Videogames and Blockchain.
Opportunity to grow within an expanding company.

About us:

Nexxyo Labs, a young vibrant technology company headquartered in Navarra. At Nexxyo, we are not just shaping the future; we are redefining it, introducing new ways to enjoy games, and pushing the boundaries of what"s possible in the tech industry.

Going beyond the conventional, our commitment extends to bringing blockchain gaming to the world. Rooted in our dual mission of delivering entertainment and fostering a global gaming community, we continually push the envelope of innovation with Web3 technology, ensuring enduring value for each player.

Please send your CV to: Ver el correo electrónico en stratos-ad.com

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de Pruebas Automáticas (QA/Tester) | REMOTO
jobs_results.description:
Localidad

Torrejón de Ardoz

Funciones:

Desde Hasten Group estamos buscando un/a Ingeniero/a de Pruebas con experiencia mínima en automatización de 2 años para trabajar con uno de nuestros principales clientes dedicados al sector de ingeniería en uno de sus proyectos internacionales en ATM.
– Modalidad: REMOTO
– Horario: Lunes a jueves 8:00-8:30 a 17:10-17:40; viernes de 8:00-8:30 a 14:30-15:00 (flexibilidad de entrada y salida).
– Contrato indefinido

¿De qué te encargarás?
– Diseñarás escenarios de prueba para asegurar el 100% de cobertura de los requisitos; prepararás casos de prueba (los que no se pueden automatizar) y scripts de prueba automatizados para probar los escenarios identificados.
– Realizarás pruebas automatizadas y manuales para garantizar que el software esté libre de defectos.
– Ejecutarás los casos de prueba requeridos y analizarás los resultados.

Requisitos:

¿Qué deberás aportar?
– Debes contar con Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Informática, Industrial... Aeronáutica o similares incluyendo los Grados en matemáticas y física.
– Experiencia mínima de 2 años en automatización de pruebas.
– Conocimientos amplios en tecnologías para automatización de pruebas (jenkins, robotfwk, pytest-BDD).
– Conocimientos de framework de pruebas (Junit, TestFX y QF-Test).
– Conocimientos en sistemas de control de versiones (Git, bitbucket).
– Conocimientos en el uso de Jira para la gestión documental y el uso de datos.
– Conocimientos en BBDD(no relacionales y relacionales).
– Conocimientos de programación con java, javafx, python, shell-scripting, bash.
– Nivel de inglés alto (mínimo B2).
– Disponibilidad para viajar en Europa (3-4 viajes a lo largo del año de 5 días, aproximadamente).

Banda salarial: 38.000-42.000 €/brutos anuales (salario flexible en función de la experiencia aportada).

Se ofrece:

¿Por qué elegirnos a nosotros?

Hasten Group somos una empresa que esta en pleno crecimiento y busca para ello contar con los mejores profesionales TIC.

Ofrecemos:
– Contratación indefinida
– Formación personalizada IT / Idiomas
– Plan de carrera profesional real
– Posibilidad de realizar multiproyectos en diversos sectores
– Integración en equipos multidisciplinares
– 23 días laborales de Vacaciones
– Revisiones salariales anuales

Nos importan las personas y su talento, por ello hacemos seguimientos continuados de nuestros empleados, velamos por el bienestar y la realización de promociones anuales.
¡Juntos crecemos haciendo lo que nos gusta!

Si te gustan los retos y quieres seguir creciendo en el área Tecnológica, ¡Somos tu empresa

jobs_results.title: QA Manager
jobs_results.description:
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

The Stumble Guys franchise is now available on console and has been enjoyed by millions of players. The team is based in Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players.

What You Will Do
• Lead external and internal Console QA team on a world-leading franchise title
• Manage, provide technical expertise and career development for a team that is keen to grow and develop
• Build on existing team metrics for measurement of quality and operational excellence
• Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders, partners, and executives
• Establish... and maintain strong communication with cross-functional teams for both internal and external development, QA and Localization partners
• Work with team leads on how to create efficient plans, assignments, and schedules for associated quality functions
• Continually improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the QA & Deployment effort by assessing current practices and incorporating new strategies
• Be the internal advocate and spokesperson for all things QA & Deployment while clearly communicating issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders
• Be an advocate and spokesperson for Automation Engineering efforts

What We’re Looking For
• 6+ years quality assurance professional
• 2 + years of management experience in a full software development cycle
• Experience within the console gaming space on a live title with a high active user base
• Deep understanding of quality assurance techniques, frameworks and methodologies
• Ability to influence change that achieves exceptional product quality
• Experience training and improving testing as an embedded function in multi-disciplined agile feature teams.
• Experience in working with remote teams and working with a cross-functional team
• Demonstrated knowledge of software testing, software QA processes, software development processes, change management and process improvement.
• Demonstrated experience of different bug tracking software and test plan management solutions
• Experience on mobile gaming is also a plus

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Us

Scopely is a global interactive entertainment and mobile-first video game company, home to many top, award-winning experiences such as "MONOPOLY GO!," “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “Stumble Guys,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” and “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” among others.

Scopely creates, publishes, and live-operates immersive games that empower a directed-by-consumer™ experience across multiple platforms--from mobile, web, PC and beyond.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is fueled by a world-class team and a proprietary technology platform Playgami that supports one of the most diversified portfolios in the games industry.

Recognized multiple times as one of Fast Company’s “World’s Most Innovative Companies,” Scopely is a multi-billion-dollar business due to its ability to create long-lasting game experiences that players enjoy for years.

Scopely has global operations in more than a dozen markets across Asia, EMEA, and North America, and is home to many internal game development teams, referred to as Scopely Studios, with additional game studio partners across four continents.

Scopely was acquired by Savvy Games Group in July 2023 for $4.9 billion, and is now an independent subsidiary of Savvy.

For more information on Scopely, visit: scopely.com.

Notice to candidates: Scopely, Inc and its affiliates will never request payment or ask for financial information as a condition for applying to a position or receiving an offer of employment. All official Scopely, Inc. recruiters only use email domains that end with @scopely.com.

Our official website is www.scopely.com. Please only apply to positions posted on our official website and ensure the recruiter only communicates via the official email domain.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact
